rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically stabbing or jabbing someone or something with a pointed object.

example.english: I accidentally stab him in the hand with a pen.
example.traditional: 我一唔小心用支筆插到佢隻手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 m4 siu2 sam1 jung6 zi1 bat1 caap3 dou2 keoi5 zek3 sau2

rows.note: Use this when something causes a sudden, sharp painful sensation, such as cold wind or snow on the face.

example.english: When the cold wind blew over, my face immediately felt a stab of pain.
example.traditional: 陣寒風吹埋嚟，我塊面即刻刺痛。
example.jyutping: zan6 hon4 fung1 ceoi1 maai4 lai4 ngo5 faai3 min6 zik1 hak1 ci3 tung3

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when someone damages another person's reputation by bad-mouthing or disparaging them.

example.english: They keep trying to stab me in the back by bad-mouthing me to the boss, so I can't get promoted.
example.traditional: 佢成日喺老闆面前唱衰我，搞到我冇得升職。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 coeng3 seoi1 ngo5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 mou5 dak1 sing1 zik1
